user.title: Add Flespi Device
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should receive data for this device.

menu_options.ha_mqtt: Via Home Assistant MQTT (requires a flespi → local broker bridge)
menu_options.direct: Direct connection to the flespi MQTT broker

data_description.dev_id: A unique name for this tracker (e.g. my_car)
data_description.topic: The MQTT topic to subscribe to on the local HA broker

direct.title: Direct connection to flespi
direct.description: Pick the device from your flespi account or enter its identifier by hand.

direct_search.title: Find a flespi device
direct_search.description: Enter your token and a name or ident substring. flespi runs the search server-side, so this scales to large accounts (up to 50 matches shown).

data_description.token: A flespi token with at least read access to the target device(s)
data_description.search: Part of the device name or ident (IMEI). Narrow the query if you have many devices.
data_description.use_tls: Recommended. Disable only if you know what you are doing.
data_description.protocol: MQTT 5 is recommended; use 3.1.1 or 3.1 for legacy compatibility.
data_description.auto_discovery: Fetch the device's telemetry snapshot via REST and create a sensor/binary_sensor for every recently-reporting parameter.
